title: Field protocol v1 diagnostic event (Field to core)
description: Bounded structured health, permission, rate-limit, truncation, skipped-content, refetch, or damage information. The code vocabulary is closed at v1. The Field must classify and sanitize before emitting, replacing removed material with the exact marker '[redacted]' and naming what it removed. Core applies a second redaction pass before display or persistence. Redaction is an obligation on Fieldnotes' own output; it is never a reason to reject collected evidence.

severity.description: 'error' means the run cannot be reported complete: it disqualifies any snapshot completeness claim and any deletion by absence, even if the process later exits zero.

message.description: Already-redacted human-readable text. Actionable, and free of source payloads, HTTP traces, tokens, cookies, signed URLs, and protected-channel material.

source.description: The portable exact-source key this diagnostic is about, when it is about one object. A diagnostic about a source object never implies its deletion.

retry_after_seconds.description: Source-supplied backoff hint. Advisory; core owns retry and backoff policy.

redacted.description: Names of the members or upstream fields whose values the Field removed before emitting. Present whenever any value was replaced by the redaction marker, so a reviewer can see that redaction happened rather than guessing.
